planets.name: TOI-1347 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1347 with a 4.84-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1347 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1347. Its orbit and size follow Rubenzahl et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
